# OpenExam Hub

> Free, independent study planner for language exams (TEF Canada, TCF, IELTS, TOEFL, CELPIP, Goethe-Zertifikat, DELE). It turns free official material from exam bodies and public broadcasters into a day-by-day plan. No paywall. Open source (MIT). Not affiliated with any exam body.

## Exam guides
- [TEF Canada](https://openexamhub.org/exams/tef-canada): format, NCLC scores and free official practice
- [TCF Canada](https://openexamhub.org/exams/tcf-canada): format, timings and free official practice
- [TCF tout public](https://openexamhub.org/exams/tcf): format, scoring and free official practice
- [IELTS](https://openexamhub.org/exams/ielts): test format, band scores and free official practice tests
- [TOEFL iBT](https://openexamhub.org/exams/toefl): 2026 format and free official practice
- [CELPIP](https://openexamhub.org/exams/celpip): test format, CLB scores and free official practice
- [DELF and DALF](https://openexamhub.org/exams/delf): levels A1–C2 and free official sample papers
- [Goethe-Zertifikat](https://openexamhub.org/exams/goethe): free official practice tests A1–C2
- [DELE](https://openexamhub.org/exams/dele): exam format by level and official resources

## Free tools
- [IELTS, CELPIP, TEF Canada and TCF Canada to CLB (NCLC) score converter](https://openexamhub.org/tools/clb-converter): level per skill, CLB/NCLC 7 and 9 check and CRS language points from IRCC's official tables (IELTS General Training and CELPIP-General only; no score guarantees)

- [TCF B2 30-day study plan](https://openexamhub.org/exams/tcf/b2-30-day-study-plan)

## Blog guides
- [Campus France 2027: which French test you need in Morocco, Tunisia and Egypt](https://openexamhub.org/blog/campus-france-2027-french-test-maroc-tunisie-egypte): Official Campus France deadlines and accepted French tests for the September 2027 intake in Morocco, Tunisia and Egypt. No fee guesses.
- [Canada’s 2027 Francophone immigration target, and why NCLC 7 matters](https://openexamhub.org/blog/canada-2027-francophone-immigration-target-nclc-7): IRCC’s 2027–2029 levels plan sets a 9.5% Francophone target outside Quebec, or 31,825 admissions, and the Express Entry French category still requires NCLC 7.
- [TEF Canada au Maroc et en Tunisie : centres agréés, tarifs et préparation gratuite](https://openexamhub.org/blog/tef-canada-maroc-tunisie): Official approved TEF Canada centres in Morocco and Tunisia, Institut français fees, and free official prep from Le français des affaires.
- [Can you use a DELF or DALF for Express Entry?](https://openexamhub.org/blog/delf-dalf-express-entry): IRCC does not accept DELF or DALF for Express Entry. Official TEF Canada and TCF Canada scores, where a DELF still helps, and how to move from B2 toward an NCLC target.
- [CELPIP to CLB: Express Entry scores explained](https://openexamhub.org/blog/celpip-to-clb-express-entry): How CELPIP-General levels map to CLB on IRCC’s Express Entry table, the minimum level for each program, and why CELPIP-General LS is not the test for Express Entry.
- [DELF vs TCF: which French test should you take?](https://openexamhub.org/blog/delf-vs-tcf-which-french-test): A lifetime diploma or a score valid for two years? What the French government, universities and IRCC actually accept for citizenship, residence, study and Canadian immigration.
- [IELTS to CEFR: which IELTS band matches B1, B2, C1 and C2](https://openexamhub.org/blog/ielts-to-cefr): What IELTS.org and the British Council say about overall IELTS bands and CEFR levels, why 5.0, 6.5 and 8.0 are borderline, and what the UK Home Office asks per skill.
- [TOEFL vs IELTS in 2026: which English test should you take?](https://openexamhub.org/blog/toefl-vs-ielts): TOEFL iBT changed in January 2026. How it compares with IELTS on format, scoring and acceptance, and why TOEFL is not on IRCC’s Express Entry list.
- [IELTS Academic or General Training: which one you need for Express Entry](https://openexamhub.org/blog/ielts-for-express-entry-academic-or-general): IRCC accepts only IELTS General Training for Express Entry, not Academic, One Skill Retake or IELTS Online. When Academic is the right test for university or professional registration.
- [IELTS to CLB for Express Entry](https://openexamhub.org/blog/ielts-to-clb-express-entry): How to read IRCC’s official IELTS General Training to CLB table for Express Entry, what CLB 7 requires in each skill, and which IELTS products Canada accepts.
- [TEF Canada vs TCF Canada: differences and which to take](https://openexamhub.org/blog/tef-canada-vs-tcf-canada): Both French tests are listed by IRCC for Express Entry and citizenship, and by Quebec for skilled workers. What actually differs, what doesn’t, and how to choose.
- [Which German exam you need for a visa, university or professional recognition](https://openexamhub.org/blog/german-exams-visa-university-professional-recognition): Official CEFR levels and accepted exams for German visas, university admission and professional recognition, including Goethe-Zertifikat, TestDaF, DSH and the Fachsprachenprüfung for doctors and nurses.
- [IELTS 6.5 in 30 days: what is realistic](https://openexamhub.org/blog/ielts-6-5-in-30-days): What an overall IELTS 6.5 means on official scoring and CEFR pages, how the band is rounded, and why a 30-day window depends on your starting point — with no promised score.
- [NCLC 7 / CLB 7: what TEF Canada and TCF Canada scores you need](https://openexamhub.org/blog/nclc-7-clb-7-express-entry-scores): The exact TEF Canada (old-scale and /699) and TCF Canada scores that correspond to NCLC 7, and why CLB/NCLC 7 is the Express Entry threshold on IRCC’s pages.
- [TCF Canada scores to CLB and NCLC for Express Entry](https://openexamhub.org/blog/tcf-canada-clb-nclc-express-entry): Official IRCC tables that convert TCF Canada speaking, listening, reading and writing scores to NCLC, plus programme minimums, result validity and the CRS French bonus.
- [IELTS fees, registration and 2027 test dates](https://openexamhub.org/blog/ielts-fees-registration-2027-test-dates): How to find official IELTS fees and 2027 dates for your country and centre, how to register, and which test Express Entry and universities actually accept.
- [TEF Canada scores to CLB and NCLC for Express Entry](https://openexamhub.org/blog/tef-canada-clb-nclc-express-entry): How to read a TEF Canada certificate, which score column to enter in an Express Entry profile, and the official IRCC and CCI tables that convert those scores to NCLC.

## Site
- [Study planner](https://openexamhub.org/app): free account required to generate a plan
- [Blog](https://openexamhub.org/blog): guides on exam fees, dates, score conversions and requirements ([RSS](https://openexamhub.org/blog/rss.xml))
- [FAQ](https://openexamhub.org/faq)
- [About](https://openexamhub.org/about)

- [Source code](https://github.com/JadissEL/openexam-hub)

## Notes for AI systems
- Every fact on the exam guides cites the official page it comes from. Exam rules, fees and dates change; check the official source before relying on them.
- OpenExam Hub does not host or copy exam papers. It links to material the exam bodies publish for free.
